sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kw frequency converter.
The recorded demand forecast for part:350020 changed by +10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).
Our should-cost estimate for part:350020 is EUR 403.21 per price unit (cost:350020).
Your recorded on-time delivery rate is 84.6 % (sc:70530@2026Q3).
We understand your position on list prices, so we have structured the packages below around payment, volume and contract length.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation and would like an agreement that covers our full need.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
Please note:
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We appreciate your willingness to adjust payment terms to 14 days and extend the contract to 24 months.
In return for these improved terms, we can offer a revised price of €427.48 per unit.
Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, our colleagues will address this topic separately.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €427.48 per unit.
Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Our pricing follows our approval process.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
